held.reason: Current Customs primary tables and reuse basis were not obtained; syndicated reporting alone did not support five deep editions within the combined source allowance.
Company facts were verified, but a single protected results release did not provide sufficient independently usable depth. Same-release mirrors do not multiply allowance.

Company and recipient statements corroborate the pledge, not delivery. UKRI background is noncommercial-share-alike, not OGL; applicability was not established. Suitable OGL context would require a substantially reframed article.
The reported headcount review requires the five original annual-report tables and independently usable industry context; year-end headcount changes cannot be called announced October layoffs.
Current prospectus retrieval and independent verification of filing terms remained incomplete; reporting mirrors did not provide sufficient reusable depth.

The precise submitted multi-index snapshot and probability figures were not verified with a consistent market timestamp. Earlier intraday observations cannot be presented as current or closing prices.
The current regional report or transcript was not located. Reuters reporting did not substitute for an independently reviewed IMF original or provide sufficient combined source allowance.
